verdict.rationale: The first-party errors-retrying docs show retries can be set globally in trigger.config or per task, with an example task that "will retry 10 times with exponential backoff." A community comment confirms that uncaught errors trigger automatic retries in practice. That comment warns of accidental repeated side effects, which is a caution rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of backoff parameter tuning (factor, min/max delay) and step-level retry granularity within a task.
